units.source_text: 淺草的商店街有賣新年舞獅的獅子面具呢，大小很適合小孩戴在頭上玩，你不想要嗎？」

en.t: In the shopping arcade in Asakusa, they sell lion masks for the New Year lion dance, just the right size for children to wear on their heads and play with. Do you not want one?

units.source_text: 一旦被問到「你不想要嗎」，我只能舉手認輸，再也無法用搞笑的方式回答。

en.t: Once I was asked, Do you not want one, I could only give up completely and could no longer answer in a joking way.

units.source_text: 作為一位搞笑演員，我已經徹底落榜。

en.t: As a comic performer, I had failed completely.

units.source_text: 「還是書好吧？」大哥一臉認真地說道。

en.t: A book would be better, would it not? my elder brother said with a serious look.

units.source_text: 「是嗎？」父親一臉掃興，連寫都不寫，啪的一聲就合上了記事本。

en.t: Is that so? Father looked disappointed and, without even writing it down, snapped his notebook shut.

units.source_text: 這是多麼失敗啊，我竟然惹怒了父親。

en.t: What a terrible failure this was; I had actually made Father angry.

units.source_text: 父親的報復肯定很可怕。

en.t: Father's revenge would surely be terrifying.

units.source_text: 如果不趁著現在想對策，可能就無法挽回了。

en.t: If I did not think of a plan now, it might become impossible to undo the damage.
